concept.hr: Faza nositelja izravno prati vrijednost signala; kod FM to radi frekvencija
concept.en: The carrier's phase follows the signal directly; in FM, the frequency does

summary.hr: Signal, nositelj, FM i PM jedan ispod drugoga za sinus, pravokutni, pilasti i rastući signal: kod PM brid odmah skoči fazu, kod FM mijenja samo frekvenciju.
summary.en: Signal, carrier, FM and PM stacked for a sine, square, sawtooth or ramp: in PM every edge makes the phase jump at once, in FM only the frequency changes.

what.hr: Aplet applet_pm.html (usporedba FM i PM, oblici signala, nositelj od 8 titraja) i tekst odjeljka o faznoj modulaciji (50ohm.de, hrvatski prijevod)
what.en: The applet applet_pm.html (FM and PM side by side, the signal shapes, the 8-period carrier) and the text of the phase modulation section (50ohm.de, Croatian translation)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu i nacrtan kao SVG, preveden na engleski, dodani klizač pomaka faze, oznake skokova faze i predlošci
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit and drawn as SVG, translated into English, a phase shift slider, phase jump marks and presets added
